nextcloud.console.title: Console Nextcloud
nextcloud.console.subtitle: Configure the NextCloud desktop sync client settings (the application installed on users' computers). These settings do not affect the ENT's document space.
nextcloud.console.folder.location.instru: Le dossier sera créé à partir du dossier de l’utilisateur (C:) / Utilisateurs / <nom.utilisateur>. This national field is a PREFIX ("ENT_PARTAGE_UAI_" by default): each school automatically completes it with its own UAI code (e.g. ENT_PARTAGE_UAI_0561522A), unless it chooses to fully customize its own folder from its own screen.
Default folder proposed for this school: national prefix followed by its UAI code (or, if no UAI, its name in uppercase). Freely editable, for this school only.
nextcloud.console.folder.os.note: Example given for Windows. On Linux, the equivalent folder is /home/<username>/{folder}; on Mac, /Users/<username>/{folder}. This path only concerns the NextCloud sync client installed on the user's computer: the folder already exists automatically server-side, regardless of the device.
nextcloud.console.bandwidth.instructions: Maximum upload and download speed of the sync client, in kilobytes per second. A value greater than 0 is required in both fields to save. 10,000 KB/s (10 MB/s) is proposed by default: a reasonable value for a school network, to adjust based on your actual infrastructure (we cannot determine it automatically).
nextcloud.console.excluded.extensions.in: Saisir l’extension et appuyez sur Entrée pour valider. Works the same way on Windows, Linux and Mac.
nextcloud.console.save.requires.folder: To be able to save (including forbidden file types), the sync folder must be filled in AND bandwidth (both upload and download) must be greater than 0 — even if you only change one of these fields, both are required. Without it, changes are not saved and disappear when the page reloads.
nextcloud.console.alert.save: Les paramètres ont bien été sauvegardés.

nextcloud.console.share.structures.title: Cross-establishment sharing
nextcloud.console.share.structures.subti: Allow users from another establishment to appear in NextCloud sharing.
nextcloud.console.share.structures.expla: By default, only users from the same establishment see each other in the sharing picker. Search below for an establishment to allow: its users and yours will then be able to share NextCloud files with each other. This has no effect on messaging.
